# HSR Utility

> HSR Utility is an indie Android studio building carefully crafted wallpaper,
> ringtone and money-management apps for specific audiences. Its apps are Arul (South
> Indian wallpapers, live on Google Play) and Daily Passbook (a passbook of bank payments with autopay and EMI
> reminders, live on Google Play). The studio itself has no religious affiliation.

## Key facts

- **Studio:** HSR Utility. Indie Android studio, founded 2026. HSR Utility is the brand
  name; the registered company behind it is **HSR Utility Apps Private Limited**, A3002,
  Adonia Hiranandani, Garden, South AvenuePowai, Mumbai, Mumbai, Mumbai, Maharashtra,
  400076, India.
- **Apps** — all Android-only (Arul built with Flutter, Daily Passbook native Kotlin):
  - **Arul** — South Indian wallpapers. Shorts-style feed of static and live wallpapers,
    category browse, ringtones, and upload-your-own-wallpaper submissions.
    **Status: live on Google Play** —
    https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hsrutility.arul
  - **Daily Passbook** — SMS-based money management. Builds a passbook of bank debits and
    credits from the transaction messages on the phone, tracks UPI autopays, EMIs,
    subscriptions and bills with their due dates, reminds before each is due, and can
    announce each debit or credit aloud in a chosen voice language (even on Do Not
    Disturb). Alert reliability check. 10 languages (English, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil,
    Telugu, Marathi, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi). No ads; reading, parsing
    and payment history stay on the phone. Made by UtilityVerse; not a bank, moves no
    money, gives no financial advice.
    **Status: live on Google Play** —
    https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.awaazpay.android
- **Model (Arul):** browsing and previewing is always free. Applying wallpapers, setting
  ringtones and sharing are premium — ₹199/month, billed via a PhonePe UPI Autopay
  mandate rather than Google Play billing. New accounts get a one-day free trial;
  approving the mandate takes a ₹2 verification debit that the bank reverses
  automatically. **Payments already taken are strictly non-refundable**; cancelling
  is instant from inside the app and stops all future charges.
- **Model (Daily Passbook):** a plan is required. ₹2 for a one-day trial (the ₹2 is refunded),
  then ₹199/month by PhonePe UPI AutoPay, not Google Play billing. One trial per Google
  account. Cancel any time in the app (Settings → Premium → Manage Subscription).
  Payments already taken are not refunded; failed, duplicate or wrong debits are.
- **Sign-in:** Google Sign-In (name, email, profile photo). No phone number, no password.
- **Account deletion:** instant from inside any app (Arul: Settings → Delete
  account; Daily Passbook: Settings → Need Help → Delete Account); email
  support@hsrutility.com as a fallback if the app is already uninstalled (for Daily Passbook,
  from the account's own Google email address).
- **Contact:** support@hsrutility.com — replies within 48 hours. Support is email-only.
- **This website:** no analytics, no cookies, no third-party requests of any kind.

## Pages

Each app is a self-contained sub-site. Its pages describe that app alone and link
only to that app's other pages; the apps are documented separately and deliberately
do not cross-reference one another. This home page and llms.txt are the only places
the apps are listed together.

- [Home](https://hsrutility.com/): HSR Utility and its apps — positioning and overview.
- [Support & FAQ](https://hsrutility.com/support): Questions about content, pricing, sign-in, Android support, and reporting bugs.
- [Delete My Account](https://hsrutility.com/delete-account): How to permanently delete an account and its data.

### Website policies (about hsrutility.com itself, not the apps)

- [Privacy Policy](https://hsrutility.com/privacy-policy/): The website collects nothing — no analytics, no cookies, no third-party requests.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://hsrutility.com/terms/): Permitted use, intellectual property, third-party links, liability.
- [Cookie Policy](https://hsrutility.com/cookie-policy/): No cookies are set; one local-storage key holds the theme preference.
- [Refund Policy](https://hsrutility.com/refund-policy/): The studio-wide no-refund position and how to cancel.
